extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Knight-Hennessy Scholars program (graduate-degree candidates and their supporters)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for applicants preparing and submitting an application to the Knight-Hennessy Scholars (KHS) graduate scholars program at Stanford, explaining the program's goals for the application and what applicants should convey about themselves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate KHS criteria in ways unique to you
rubrics_metrics.description: The KHS application is an invitation to show how you demonstrate our criteria in ways that are unique and distinct to you.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no formula for admission; applicants should present their experiences and attributes in their own voice and context rather than trying to hit a checklist. Emphasize distinctiveness and personal demonstration of the program's criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-knowledge — what you have done
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the application to convey what you have done (past accomplishments and experiences).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The application is designed to help you better know yourself and to communicate your past achievements clearly to the selection committee; reflect on meaningful experiences rather than listing credentials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-identity — who you are now
rubrics_metrics.description: Convey who you are now — current roles, character, and perspective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe your present identity, responsibilities, and the capacities you currently bring to a scholarly and leadership community; help reviewers understand your present contribution and standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Future aspirations — what you aspire to do
rubrics_metrics.description: Articulate what you aspire to do in the future (vision, goals, intended impact).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain future goals and how the KHS experience and your graduate study fit into those aspirations; show clarity of purpose and potential for future impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Holistic evaluation — no automatic qualifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no formula for admission, and there are no scores, achievements, or stories that automatically qualify you for admission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Admissions are holistic; avoid assuming that any single metric will determine outcome. Instead, present a coherent, authentic narrative across past, present, and future dimensions to demonstrate fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete both KHS and Stanford degree applications (procedural requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applying to KHS is separate from applying to Stanford degree program(s); applicants must prepare required components for both processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and submit all required components for the KHS application and follow the separate application process and deadlines for Stanford degree programs; use available KHS resources on required components and deadlines to manage both applications.
